brief:
**BLUF:** In Tazewell County, a school bus crash Monday afternoon injured one child and one driver with non-life-threatening injuries; the at-fault driver was charged with reckless driving. A Bluefield man faces murder charges in North Carolina. Tazewell County advances a new countywide fire department (effective Oct. 15) and a women’s opioid recovery facility using settlement funds. No active NWS alerts; WV voter registration deadline today.[[1]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/12/two-injured-after-tazewell-county-school-bus-crash/)[[2]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/12/bluefield-man-accused-north-carolina-murder/)

## LAW ENFORCEMENT AND COURTS
**Tazewell County, VA (North Tazewell):** On Oct. 12 at approximately 3:51 p.m. EDT, a three-vehicle crash occurred involving a stopped school bus dropping off children (26 aboard), a car stopped behind it, and a third vehicle that struck the stopped car, pushing it into the bus. One child and the driver of the stopped car were transported to a local hospital with non-life-threatening injuries. The driver of the third vehicle was charged with reckless driving, summonsed, and released. Virginia State Trooper T.D. Parker responded. Tazewell County Public Schools issued a statement on the incident.[[1]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/12/two-injured-after-tazewell-county-school-bus-crash/)

**Bluefield, WV/VA area / Charlotte, NC:** Jamere Robert Edwards, 25, of Bluefield, was arrested Oct. 7 in connection with the shooting death of Courtney Marie Mullis, 26, of Charlotte. The incident occurred on Statesville Road; Edwards was also charged with providing a false name to police. He is held without bond in North Carolina and faces a mental health evaluation.[[2]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/12/bluefield-man-accused-north-carolina-murder/)

**Region (WV):** Drug testing of TANF recipients will continue in West Virginia. Last day to register to vote in West Virginia for the general election is today (Oct. 13). Summers County Sheriff’s Office warned about a Publishers Clearing House scam circulating.

Nothing additional reported in the last 24 hours from Tazewell County Sheriff’s Office, Richlands/Tazewell/Bluefield VA or WV police, Mercer County Sheriff, or Virginia/West Virginia State Police specific to the core area.

## FIRE, EMS AND RESCUE
**Tazewell County, VA:** Tazewell County Board of Supervisors approved the roster for a new countywide fire company, effective Oct. 15, to improve coordination, training, and response while partnering with existing volunteer departments. Stations remain in place.[[3]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/07/tazewell-county-approves-firefighter-list-new-countywide-department/)

Nothing else reported in the last 24 hours.

## HAZARDS, WEATHER AND ROADS
No active NWS alerts for the core area. VDOT reports ongoing projects including Second Street/Front Street intersection improvements in Richlands (completion November 2026) and Route 19/460 and Route 610 intersection improvements in Claypool Hill (completion December 2026).[[4]](https://swvasun.com/index26.htm)

Nothing else reported in the last 24 hours for flooding, outages, or major closures on US-19, US-460, US-52, Route 16, Route 67, or I-77 in the core.

## GOVERNMENT AND POLITICS
**Tazewell County, VA:** Board of Supervisors approved purchase of property in the North Tazewell area for a residential women’s opioid recovery facility operated by Hope and Future, using opioid settlement funds (project in development since 2023). Town of Tazewell Council meets tonight (Oct. 13) at 7:30 p.m. in council chambers (executive session at 6:30 p.m.), with items including financial reports, automated license plate readers, and a public hearing set for Nov. 10 on comprehensive plan update.[[5]](https://www.bdtonline.com/news/local_news/tazewell-county-oks-property-for-women-s-opioid-recovery-facility/article_823abf71-a1aa-4af8-ad75-fab420aafd3e.html)

**West Virginia (region):** Drug testing of TANF recipients continues. Voter registration deadline for general election is today.

## ECONOMY AND OTHER
**Tazewell County, VA / Bluefield area:** Tazewell County Public Schools celebrating National School Lunch Week. West Virginia gas prices average $4.24 per gallon. Bluefield State professor featured on the Today show.[[6]](https://wvmetronews.com/2026/10/08/bluefield-man-charged-with-charlotte-murder/)

**Region:** Food City donated $30,000 to Feeding Southwest Virginia’s Mobile Marketplace serving sites including Tazewell. SWCC mourns founding President Dr. Charles R. King.[[4]](https://swvasun.com/index26.htm)

## WATCH -- NEXT 48 HOURS
- Tazewell Town Council meeting tonight (Oct. 13, 7:30 p.m.).
- New Tazewell County Fire Company begins operations Oct. 15.
- WV voter registration closes today (Oct. 13).
- Ongoing VDOT road work in Richlands and Claypool Hill areas.
